product_metadata.title: K2 New Signature Collection Queen Size Sea Turtles Korean Mink Blanket
features: Easy Care, machine wash and dry.
description: Colorful gorgeous elusive and plushthe "12 Turtles" mink blanket from our signature collection is all this and much more. With an intricate design and a visually pleasing style the super-soft faux-fur blanket is 79 x 96-inches so it easily fits a queen or king-sized bed. It also weighs 6-lbs making it one of our thicker heavy-weight pieces. Since it is 100% Polyester it is totally machine washable and air-dries quickly.This means that you can easily use it as a comforter as a throw for your sofa or in your car and even as a durable camping or beach blanket. If it gets dirty just toss it in the wash and it is ready by bedtime. Featuring 12 turtles hidden against a blue ocean background this blanket is as fun as it is beautiful. Give one as a gift to your favorite person to snuggle with and search for the turtles together.
